title: BRIEFING
universal_lens: The audit framework formalizes a constrained optimization over live market states, enforcing strict boundary conditions via negative control sets. By projecting candidate lines into a Wilson confidence interval space, the system guarantees that any non-positive lower confidence bound triggers a deterministic collapse to an abstention state.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps the live ESPN feed data into a high-dimensional feature space, applying conformal inference to quantify distributional shifts between legacy and inflated lines. The Bayesian posterior probability of positive edge is rigorously bounded; if the 95% lower confidence bound fails positivity, the model enforces a hard zero-allocation constraint.
gse_mapping: GSE models the audit as a finite state machine where transitions are governed by Law 9 and Doctrine 5. Incoming telemetry from roster gates acts as event triggers; upon detecting inactive athletes or invalid line structures, the engine deterministically transitions to a BLOCKED state, preventing execution.

primitives.verbatim_quote: - Demonstrated that all candidate lines (legacy and inflated live) produce non-positive Wilson 95% LCB edge, properly failing closed to ABSTAIN under Law 9 / Standing Doctrine 5.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: LCB_95: Lower Confidence Bound at 95% (dimensionless probability), E: Expected edge (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Edge estimates follow a binomial proportion distribution amenable to Wilson score intervals.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If LCB_95 <= 0, the operator forces a hard transition to the ABSTAIN state.

primitives.name: Negative Roster Control Veto
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Tested and verified negative controls: David Montgomery on DET -> BLOCKED; Andy Dalton on CAR -> BLOCKED; Diontae Johnson on CAR -> BLOCKED; Saquon Barkley on PHI -> BLOCKED.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: A: Athlete entity, T: Team entity, S: Active status (boolean)
primitives.assumptions: Roster APIs accurately reflect current active/inactive/injured designations for the target game week.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Triggers immediate BLOCKED state if A is not in T's active lineup.

layer2.telemetry: 100% block rate on specified inactive/mismatched athlete queries.

The audit architecture functions as a rigorous mathematical filter applied to stochastic market inputs. We begin by defining the state space of the Detroit vs. Carolina matchup, parameterized by live ESPN feeds and DraftKings odds. The core operator relies on the Wilson score interval to bound the expected edge. Let p be the observed win rate and n the sample size. The lower confidence bound LCB_95 provides a conservative estimate of true edge. If LCB_95 <= 0, the system invokes Law 9, collapsing the decision tree to an ABSTAIN state. This prevents exposure to statistically insignificant or negative expectation bets. Concurrently, the roster gate operates as a discrete boolean filter. By testing negative controls—athletes known to be inactive or mismatched—we verify the integrity of the state-transition logic. The successful blocking of entities like David Montgomery confirms that the system correctly parses roster APIs and enforces hard constraints. The dual application of statistical bounding and logical gating ensures that only robust, legally compliant opportunities survive the audit pipeline. The emission of signed artifacts serves as a cryptographic proof of this computational process, guaranteeing reproducibility and adherence to Standing Doctrines.

reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models the sportsbook as an adversarial agent continuously optimizing its liability. By evaluating both legacy and inflated live lines, the audit anticipates market manipulation or delayed pricing adjustments. The negative roster controls simulate an opposing agent attempting to exploit inactive player mismatches. By proactively blocking these vectors, the engine demonstrates a predictive understanding of potential exploitation attempts, maintaining a defensive posture against structural arbitrage failures.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced by decoupling the statistical edge calculation from the roster validity check. Even if a line presents a theoretically positive LCB_95, a failed roster gate instantly vetoes the action. This cross-layer veto prevents leakage where a statistical anomaly might mask a fundamental eligibility flaw. The CI anti-bypass scan further ensures that no hardcoded shortcuts circumvent these dual verification layers, preserving the epistemic integrity of the entire audit chain.
